extension.description: Create, verify, and prepare GOVP evidence in VS Code, even without an account, network access, or MCP.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Local receipts and the publication queue require a persistent file system.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Local verification is available; observation, bundle application, and MCP remain disabled until the workspace is trusted.
configuration.domain: HTTPS origin owned by the project. It is used to compose attribution; the extension never receives the domain private key.
configuration.mcpEndpoint: Optional GOVP MCP HTTPS endpoint ending in /mcp. Credentials are not allowed in the URL.
configuration.partnerUrl: Optional HTTPS URL for the partner channel. No Preview endpoint is configured by default.
configuration.mcpProviderNamespace: Exact namespace used by VS Code to bind tools to the GOVP Implementation MCP server.
configuration.observeLocalExecution: Create local receipts after tasks and tests that actually ran.
